integrity: The all-parameter statement has a finite-geometric proof; finite computational checks are corroborative, not a universal or independent certificate.
scientific_limitations: The proof assumes q is a prime power and d is an integer at least 4.
The maximal clique structure and the strong-metric reduction are established prior results; the new claim is the full enumerator and complete incidence interpretation.
Earlier unindexed clique-polynomial formulas could duplicate the enumerator; publication priority has not received independent review.
title: Strong-resolving polynomials of rank-two Grassmann graphs over finite fields
